Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today!

Name: Buford
Dialog: A quilt?! No way! I mean, I know it's been a long summer and you guys are running out of ideas and-

Name: Isabella
Dialog: That's okay. Buford. You don't have to hang with us everyday.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No no, I'm in! I'm in! I don't wanna play alone. I'll turn into a cat-kid.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What's a cat-kid?

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's the kid version of a cat lady.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Quick! Somebody say "Where's Perry?".

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Where's Perry?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sighs happily) You're always there for me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (turns around) Oh, it's you.

Name: Doofenshimirtz
Dialog: Yeah, sorry, no time for a trap. It's nothing personal, you see today is the annual L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Summer Stock Festival and I got the title role, so I have to take over the Tri-State Area by 3:30 if I wanna make curtain! Uh, that doesn't leave me much time for, you know, the trapping and the fighting. So instead I built this! The Trip-To-The-Desert-inator! It's going to send you to the desert, and I can get on with my day. (Activates the -inator, Perry starts to run away) And don't bother running, 'cause I've installed a Perry-Track-inator. It's going to follow you no matter where you go-

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, great! Now I'm in the middle of nowhere! Now I'll never be able to take over the Tri-State Area before- (Gasps) The play. (Perry starts to leave via his jetpack) Wait, wait, d-don't leave me here! Uh, Perry the Platypus, please! It's important to me! A-And if this works out, I might give up evil for acting! Won't you give me that chance, to succeed at something that might very well turn my life away from the evil path? Do it for the kids. Do it for the orphans.... that I might perform in front of someday if I ever do a show in an orphanage.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I don't want to be ungrateful or anything, but is there any way to speed this up? I gotta be in the make-up chair at 4 o'clock. Hey, what about this turbo switch? That oughta shave off some time, huh? right? yeah? (Flips the switch which causes the jetpack to sped off into the distance as him and Perry fall and land on the ground) Some pilot you are. (Glares back at Perry, who then points accusingly at him) Oh sure, blame the victim. Like you didn't know about my switch-flipping compulsion. (Perry starts to run away angrily) Oh, now you're mad, sure, I don't know why I tried to be nice, I should have just trapped you, I could have been out of the hospital and on my way to the theater by now. (Starts to walk towards Perry) Instead they'll end up using my understudy. Ughh, I hate that guy!

Name: Rodney
Dialog: So, if Doofenshmirtz is late, I get to go on?

Name: Man #1
Dialog: If he's not back in time for his entrance, you can have the part.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I guess it is summer and we're in the desert, but I-I feel like it's unseasonably warm out here. I feel warm. Do you feel warm? Why do we always see cow skulls in the desert? And why do you only see the skull? Did the body die somewhere else? It-It makes no sense. (Perry walks away) Oh, I'm sorry, am I talking too much for you? Fine. I'll be quiet. I can shut up. I don't have to talk all the time. It's not like I have to fill the space.... If you want silence, I'll give you silence! You watch!... And it's gonna be deafening! Mark my words!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Why do they say "Mark my words?" I mean, they-they just mean listen to my words, why don't they just say "Listen to my words"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, look how big the sun is through this magnifying glass. (Gets harmed off-screen) Ow! Ow! Oh!...No really, it's huge, you should see it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he drives a taxi, for heavens' sake, he can work anywhere. But he expects her to just pack up and move to Vegas. Seriously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was sure my arm would grow back, but it never did. (taps his left arm which makes a metallic sound) See? Pure titanium. It's a fact.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You don't communicate, you know that? Y-You don't share. I-I know nothing about your private life. Perry closed off...... Closed, that's you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So I never touched an iguana again. Actually, that's not entirely true. There was one time, back in a—oh! Ooh ooh ooh! Look, Perry the Platypus, look! Yeah yeah you see? Two tires and an axle! Ahh, pretty soon we'll be rolling out of here! We're just gotta-gotta hop this fence. (Perry waves a finger back and forth) What do you mean no?! (Perry points to a "No Trespassing" sign on the gate) No trespassing! Oh-oh you gotta be kidding! You know what Perry the Platypus? I just had my third realization of the day, I had two earlier but I didn't share them with you. I've realized that the thing that's kept me from succeeding all this years isn't my parents not showing up for my birth, it isn't my eight month stint as organ grinder monkey, it isn't the time I got my arm stuck under that boulder, also titanium see? (taps his right arm which also makes a metallic sound), it isn't any of those things. You know what it is? It's you! (points to Perry, who then crosses him arms) You are what's been holding me back all these years.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sarcastically) Oh, very clever. Take my accusing finger and point it back at me. (Normal) So-So you think I'm responsible for my failures? (Perry nods) Well, you're wrong! I can prove it. If you would just let **me** try my junkyard scheme without interfering, it will prove to you that **you** are the source of all my failures!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh a little boost here, Perry the Platypus. (Perry crosses his arms) No, no, you're right, by myself. Okay all I have to do is- (gets zapped, dogs are heard and chase after Doofenshmirtz off-screen)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, okay, just this once I failed and you had nothing to do with it, but did you have to let me trip **all** three bear traps? I mean c'mon! I'm out here in the hot sun working on ways to get us back to Danville (They both stop walking and look at each other) and you've never even offered me so much as a glass of water or a-or a tetanus shot! I'm going it alone. As a matter of fact, I'm sick of you and your smug face! I don't wanna see it any more. I'm going to close my eyes and count to 3, (covers eyes) and when I'm done, you'd better be gone. (Perry already disappears) And it'll be just like when you're here except you (Points to where Perry is last seen) won't **be** here! (Counts) 1...2...3! (Open his eyes) Hey! He really.... FINE THEN! I can find the bus station on my own.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (crawling; pants) I said I wanted a sea otter for Christmas, they said I have to pick my present from the bottom shelf of the kitchen caustics aisle at the supermarket so I picked the oven cleaner. I loved that oven cleaner. OVEN CLEANER!! (notices a bus station) Hey, a bus station!

Name: Bus Driver
Dialog: Danville's and points east! (Doofenshmirtz stands up) Ticket please!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (pants) I-I don't have a ticket but I... I've got to get to Danville to be in a play! I-I've just gotta, I don't have any money, I'm tired and dirty, it's all my fault, I've.. It's always been my fault! I'm a failure, I'm a failure! (begins to cry off-screen) (while crying off-screen) I'm a failure.

Name: Bus Driver
Dialog: So... no ticket?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (while crying) I'm a failure. (Perry shows up with two tickets in hand, he stops crying) Two bus tickets? (Grabs the tickets) Oh Perry the Platypus, you're a mensch. I-I know I can be testy and unpleasant, I know I tend to ramble on and on, to be fair, the-the burden of conversation is kinda all on me in our relationship. And I know that I haven't always given you the respect you deserve, anyway, I want you to know that you are appreciated Perry the Platypus. You. Are. Appreciated. Oh, hey now, check it out. Look, see? A tear. The universal secretion for sincerity. (Doofenshmirtz catches his tear in a phial) I-I'll just save that for next time. Come on. You can have a window seat.

Name: Driver
Dialog: Hold it! No animals allowed!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Tough break. Thanks for the ticket though.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sweet! It's air conditioned in here!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To nobody in particular) It's not like I wanted to go to the desert. He-He just jet-packed into me and dragged me along. No animals on the bus, it's not my rule. It's-It's company policy. It's not my fault.

Name: Passenger
Dialog: Are you talking to me?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And what does he expect, he's my nemesis. I'm a stone-cold villain. I'm ruthless. I have no "ruthes". ... Still he...he looked so sad and pathetic when the bus pulled away, and—AH, I should think of something else. Kreplach! Kreplach! Eastern European comfort food. You like kreplach?

Name: Passenger
Dialog: As a matter of fact I do. When I was a little girl, my grandmother and I would make kreplach. First we would roll out th--

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enough of your blabbering on and on! My little nemesis is out there all alone. I-I can't believe it! Stop the bus! Stop the Bus! Stop-

Name: Passenger 2
Dialog: What's going on?

Name: Passenger 3
Dialog: Hey what gives?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I can't believe it.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Enjoying the shade Perry the Platypus? It's your jetpack! I found it stuck in the mouth of a fiberglass dinosaur I mean how often does that happen when you really need it? Climb aboard. Come on! Come on! Hahaha.

Name: Man
Dialog: One minute 'till curtain.

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Looks like Doofy's a no-show.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, we're running out of time! We're not gong to make it!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: '(Perry straps Doofenshmirtz tightly into the jetpack)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Are you trapping me? But we were getting along so- (Perry motions towards the turbo switch) The turbo switch!? Are you kidding? I-I can't control this thing at that speed. O-Okay Perry the Platypus, if you think so... (Perry throws the switch)

Name: Rodney
Dialog: Oh well Doofenshmirtz, the show must go on, without you. ...And there's my cue.

Name: Connie
Dialog: (acting on stage) ...I shall never go hungry again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Pizza delivery!

Name: L.O.V.E.M.U.F.F.I.N. Member
Dialog: What an entrance!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (To Perry) Haha! We got him good! And I couldn't have done it without you. (Perry turns Doofenshmirtz's finger towards himself) Oh, why Perry the Platypus... (Doofenshmirtz put the tear he collected earlier back into his eye) See I knew I'd need it later.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That was amazing! I never thought quilting could be so much fun! Think of the possibilities! Needlepoint! Embroidery! Tapestry! I'm headin' down to the fabric store right now! (walks away) Broquet! Taffeta! Saddle stitch!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Actually I didn't find it all that exciting.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, me either.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Never getting that day back.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Whew, stinker-roo.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I mean, he drives a taxi, for heavens' sake, he can work anywhere. He expects her to just pack up and move to Vegas. Seriously.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah...
